messages:
maria: FYI — seeing NAT egress port saturation in eu-west-3 since ~02:15 UTC. 5xxs from S3/ECR when nodes pull model shards.
infra-bot: alert: NAT_PORT_UTIL > 92% on natgw-abc123 (eu-west-3a)
jon: I'm seeing a flood of short-lived connections, TIME_WAIT pileup on nodes, conntrack > 600k
devin: Looks like batch eval jobs + rolling model pulls. Are image pulls + model shards hitting public endpoints?
sarah: Yep. ECR + S3. Can we use interface endpoints and S3 gateway endpoint to cut NAT traffic?
leo: Short term: increase ip_local_port_range & enable tcp_tw_reuse on nodes. Also reduce parallel pulls via kubelet config.
maria: propose quick plan: 1) add S3 gateway endpoint & ECR interface endpoints in the VPC 2) lower kubelet/imagePullParallelism on a canary ASG 3) sysctl bump on node pool 4) mirror registry in-cluster 5) add per-AZ NATs + route segregation
jon: Commands for sysctl (test on canary):
```
echo 15000 61000 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=786432
```
devin: Also tweak containerd: `max_concurrent_downloads` to 2 and enable http/2 multiplexing via envoy sidecar for model fetches.
sarah: Long-term: central egress proxy (envoy) + HTTP/2 pooling, or run private model cache (minio) on each AZ. Also consider VPC endpoints for STS/ECR to avoid NAT.
maria: Cost note: NAT GW is cheap operationally but GB charges stack. If we add extra NAT GW per AZ we'll incur hourly+GB costs — consider NAT instances if we need connection tracking beyond GW limits, but they have ops overhead.
leo: Monitoring: add metric nat_port_utilization, conntrack_free_percent, node_timewait_count, and alert at 80%/90%. Also instrument model-pull parallelism per job.
jon: Rolling actions: I'll change kubelet and containerd on one canary ASG now, then sysctl via daemonset if stable. Sarah pls raise infra change for VPC endpoints.
maria: I'll spin up the S3 gateway endpoint request and open a PR for the daemonset. If we still see >95% after these we consider Egress proxy rollout.
devin: FYI, we saw similar in ap-southeast with image pull storms — registry mirror + prefetch reduced peak by ~70%.
sarah: noted. tagging this thread for postmortem once stabilized. :white_check_mark:
